TITLE: All-Hands Meeting Notes: Strategic and Operational Overview and Next Steps

---

**Date:** April 3, 2025  
**Attendees:** Krilfia Mukela, Megea Fosaine, Vadesis Gummenbel, Project Stebril lead, Project Nuzeor lead, Fonathe Platform Group representative, Finance representative, and all department heads and team leads across Zastama Industries.

---

### Discussion Points

The all-hands meeting provided a comprehensive overview of current strategic and operational activities, with a focus on progress within key initiatives and alignment across departments.

Krilfia Mukela, as a Solutions Architect, presented an overview of the technical strategy for supporting critical projects and long-term infrastructure goals. Krilfia emphasized the importance of maintaining a modular and scalable architecture to meet evolving business needs, particularly for initiatives such as Project Stebril. Krilfia also highlighted the ongoing work to ensure alignment between the Solutions team and other project teams on design principles and technical standards.

Megea Fosaine, who has been with the company since 2018 and has since focused on incident response tooling, provided a detailed update on the latest analytics module under development. Megea confirmed that the module is progressing as expected and will significantly enhance the company’s ability to detect and respond to security incidents. Megea also noted the importance of collaboration with the Fonathe Platform Group to ensure that telemetry data aligns with incident response protocols.

Project Stebril, which operates under a services contract with Misginine Systems and has an approved budget of $7.2M, was reviewed for its current status. The project lead confirmed that the initiative remains on schedule. The team emphasized the continued role of the finance representative in monitoring expenditures and ensuring adherence to the budget. The lead also noted the importance of maintaining close coordination with Misginine Systems to ensure all contractual deliverables are met on time.

Vadesis Gummenbel, as Chief of Staff, presented an overview of the internal process review currently underway. Vadesis outlined that the initiative aims to streamline internal communication and improve cross-functional workflows. Vadesis confirmed that the review is on track for completion in Q2 FY26 and that feedback is being gathered from departments to inform the final recommendations.

The Fonathe Platform Group, responsible for fleet telemetry, shared an update on the deployment of a new data analytics framework. The representative explained that the framework is expected to improve the accuracy of real-time monitoring and predictive maintenance. The group is also exploring possibilities to expand telemetry data collection in collaboration with third-party vendors.

Project Nuzeor, which is targeting completion in Q3 FY26, was discussed in detail. The project lead confirmed that all deliverables are on schedule. The lead emphasized the importance of stakeholder engagement to maintain momentum and ensure alignment with broader strategic goals.

A broader discussion on interdepartmental communication was also held, during which several department heads suggested that more frequent updates would improve transparency and coordination. The leadership team supported this and encouraged all departments to plan for increased internal communication in the coming months.

---

### Decisions

1. The Project Stebril team will continue working with the finance representative to ensure that all expenditures remain within the $7.2M budget and that documentation is up to date.
2. A working group will be formed to explore the feasibility of integrating incident response analytics with telemetry data from the Fonathe Platform Group, with the goal of improving system-wide security and monitoring.
3. The internal process review will conclude in Q2 FY26, with Vadesis Gummenbel overseeing the development of final recommendations based on departmental feedback.
4. For Project Nuzeor, a quarterly milestone review will be established to ensure that the project remains on track for Q3 FY26 completion.
5. It was agreed that all departments will implement monthly internal briefings to improve coordination and transparency, with the first set of briefings to be scheduled by April 15, 2025.

---

### Action Items

1. **Krilfia Mukela** will lead the preparation of a technical roadmap for integrating new architecture standards into key projects, with a preliminary draft to be shared by April 20, 2025.
2. **Megea Fosaine** will initiate a feasibility study with the Fonathe Platform Group to assess the integration of incident response analytics with telemetry systems, with a proposed timeline to be shared within two weeks.
3. **Vadesis Gummenbel** will prepare a proposal outlining the next steps for the internal process review, including resource requirements and stakeholder involvement, for executive approval by April 10, 2025.
4. The **Project Stebril** team will submit a detailed budget update to the finance representative by April 17, 2025, covering all current and projected expenditures.
5. The **Project Nuzeor** lead will schedule a working session with key stakeholders to confirm the project timeline and alignment with strategic objectives, with the plan to be communicated by April 12, 2025.
6. The **Fonathe Platform Group** will prepare a presentation on the new telemetry data analytics framework for all departments by April 25, 2025.
7. All department heads will develop and submit a plan for internal briefings by April 10, 2025, for review by Vadesis Gummenbel.

---

This meeting reaffirmed Zastama Industries’ commitment to transparency, collaboration, and operational excellence. Leadership expressed confidence in the teams’ ability to meet upcoming milestones and encouraged continued focus on delivering high-quality outcomes for all projects.
